summary.zh-Hans: 芝加哥河滨步道沿芝加哥河主支的南岸延伸，以连续的步行空间连接不同滨水区段。
summary.en: The Chicago Riverwalk follows the south bank of the Chicago River’s main branch, linking waterfront sections with a continuous promenade.

names.zh-Hans: 科学与工业博物馆耳语展厅

summary.zh-Hans: 耳语展厅两端有弧形声盘和站位标记，利用展厅形状反射声音，让两端的人听见彼此的轻声说话。
summary.en: The Whispering Gallery has curved dishes and standing markers at opposite ends. Its shape reflects sound so visitors can hear a partner’s quiet voice across the room.

summary.zh-Hans: 深盘披萨有较高的饼边，容纳奶酪等配料，番茄酱铺在上方。
summary.en: Chicago deep dish pizza has a tall crust holding cheese and other fillings, with tomato sauce on top.

summary.zh-Hans: 芝加哥的意式牛肉三明治以面包夹薄切烤牛肉，配牛肉汁，可选甜椒或辣腌菜。
summary.en: Chicago’s Italian beef sandwich puts thin-sliced roast beef in bread with beef jus, with sweet peppers or hot pickled vegetables as options.
